5508 Chios {khee'-os}

來源不明; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Chios 1; 1

基阿 = "被雪覆蓋的, 多雪的"
1) 愛琴海中的一個島, 介在撒摩和Lesbos之間, 距呂大的海岸不遠 (#徒20:15|)

5508 Chios {khee'-os}

of uncertain derivation;; n pr loc

AV - Chios 1; 1

Chios = "snowy"
1) is an island in the Aegean, between Samos and Lesbos, not far
   from the shore of Lydia
